name: SKILL AT ARMS
text: Once per turning point, for no CP: pick one Skill at Arms (Light 'Em Up, Strike Fast, Ice In Your Veins or For Cadia!). Every friendly Kasrkin has it until the Ready step of the next Strategy phase. With the Sergeant in the killzone you pick two different skills.

name: ELIMINATION PATTERN
text: This turning point, a friendly Kasrkin shooting with a hot-shot weapon at an enemy that cannot retain any cover saves, or that is scanned, has Piercing Crits 1 (a hot-shot volley gun gets Piercing 1 instead).

name: ENGAGE FROM COVER
text: This turning point, a friendly Kasrkin being shot while it is in cover may re-roll one of its defence dice.

name: CLEARANCE SWEEP
text: Place your Clearance Sweep marker anywhere in the killzone. A friendly Kasrkin within 5 inches of it (horizontally) shooting an enemy also within 5 inches of it has Ceaseless. The marker goes at the next Ready step; Tactical Command can move it.

name: RELOCATE
text: Not in turning point 1. Pick a friendly Kasrkin more than 3 inches from every enemy: it and each other friendly Kasrkin within 3 inches of it that is also more than 3 inches from every enemy may each take a free Dash, in the order you choose. Costs 0 CP when the Recon-Trooper is the one picked.

name: SEIZE THE INITIATIVE
text: As the Firefight phase begins, if you do not hold initiative: one friendly Kasrkin performs one 1 AP action for free, as long as the action does not move it.

name: COVER RETREAT
text: When a friendly Kasrkin performs Fall Back while visible to and within 6 inches of another ready friendly Kasrkin that is not in an enemy control range, that other operative may perform a free Shoot once the move is done and before the Fall Back ends (changing its order to Engage if it must).

name: NEUTRALISE TARGET
text: After rolling attack dice for a friendly Kasrkin shooting an enemy that cannot retain any cover saves or is scanned: re-roll any of your attack dice.

name: GIVE NO GROUND
text: During a friendly Kasrkin's activation, or at the end of the Firefight phase: pick an objective marker or one of your mission markers. If the friendly Kasrkin contesting it total exactly 2 APL and the enemy operatives contesting it also total exactly 2, you control it (until the activation ends, or until the next turning point starts).
